item: 09 Ice Golem death freeze: outer ring thaws earlier than centre
unit: s earlier at the edge than at the centre (edge/centre duration ratio ~0.90)

samples.note: Onset (first blue field) 1216.15-1216.28; walls on the left edge of the field thaw at 1224.81; last blue at the centre gone 1225.88 (sampled at 7.5 fps, +-0.13 s each). Centre duration ~9.66 s, edge ~8.59 s, ratio 0.89. Duration ~9.5 s identifies it as an Ice Golem death freeze (L9 offense 9 s per wiki), commentator says 'Ice golem freezes early'. Camera pans slowly during the freeze; edge/centre assignment is by eye, not by measured tile distance.

Onset 199.343 (first blue frame, +-1 frame); the building at the field edge (top right) loses its ice at 207.80 (+-0.08 s; a small camera pan happens between 207.72 and 207.80, so this could be up to ~0.1 s early); blue at the centre gone 208.64. Centre ~9.30 s, edge ~8.46 s, ratio 0.91. Evidence still: docs/video-evidence/icegolem-freeze-pHPMdLcXveY-207.jpg (left: 206.8 s, walls still frozen; right: 207.9 s, edge thawed, centre still blue).

Automatic blue-pixel count over the game area (not frame-checked by eye): the second of two overlapping freeze fields starts at 862.1 and its area shrinks gradually from 870.5 to 871.6 rather than vanishing in one step; total ~9.4 s. Supports a shrinking (outer-first) thaw but the edge/centre split is not measured directly. Low weight.

confidence: low-medium: 2 frame-checked samples + 1 automatic; edge vs centre position judged by eye. Matches the game data pattern for the Freeze Spell (spells.csv FreezeOuterTimeMS = 90% of FreezeTimeMS), which suggests the Ice Golem uses the same 90% outer ring.

item: 08 Freeze Spell: outer ring thaws earlier than centre
confidence: not measured from video: every long freeze field examined lasted ~9 s (Ice Golem, not a spell), and no clean single Freeze Spell was found. Game data (data/gamecsv/v18.200.9/spells.csv) already answers it: FreezeOuterTimeMS = 0.9 x FreezeTimeMS (L7 5500/4950 ms), i.e. the outer ring thaws 0.55 s earlier at L7.
not measured: no explosion was found where the triggering contact and the pop-up of a small Bomb were both visible (blasts seen were projectiles, or the trap sat at a frame edge during a camera pan).

not measured: candidates were iK1yGLjF2Us @ ~820 s (Giant Bomb on an invisible RC, hidden under spell effects) and aRUj8A45u4A @ 556 s (game window too small in the stream layout). The trigger frame could not be found.
